description: This is a main front-end source file for a Next.js React application component responsible for persona creation, editing, and management. It handles UI state, file uploads, orchestration API interactions, and rendering of different workflow steps related to persona generation, including upload interface, draft management, and version history.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array if possible, filtering for non-empty strings.

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Safely serializes a value to a prettified JSON string, falling back to String representation if serialization fails.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a user-friendly error message from various error types.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-empty object.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a label string for avatar display.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested properties in an object given a path array, returning value and path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs available keys in an object, mainly for debugging payload shape.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from an orchestration response, with fallback candidates and shape checks.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend JSON persona data into the UI's PersonaData shape, handling various possible structures.
